item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las drag po'i las mtha' sri 'dul
item.coloph: ces pa'i stag la phur shams can gyi sri 'dul 'di rgya rong brag steng dmar po ri yi gsang brag zab gter rin po che spyan drangs te/ phyis su 'brug ri bkra shis khyung rdzong gi dgon gnas bla grwa yongs kyis bskul ba dang*/ nye bar gter grogs dbang gi sgron ma/ mchog spral rnams kyi bzhed ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas dag par phab ste/ yi ge pa ni mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o//
